notes: Restraint only. Six kinds kept as planned; Mixed seafood renamed Seafood mix. Dropped its eight 'models' (Lake Iseo, Noli Gulf, Orbetello lagoon, Porto Cesareo, Secche di Ugento, Torre Guaceto, Gulf of Selinunte, Lake Trasimeno): Slow Food fishery presidia, i.e. fisheries rather than products. Bafun and murasaki uni moved from models to types; Hamanaka uni GI and Hiyama sea cucumber GI kept (Japanese names in brackets). No new kinds, no web research.
